text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaaawn*... I apologize... I was trying 
to come up with a new maxim... and I 
just... couldn't fall asleep...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Umm... what was the proverb I just thought 
of again...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Sakura Chiyono O wasn't able to 
get much rest...
